title: Quick Crispy British Fish Wrap
description: A peppery and crispy British dish featuring fish sauce, perfect for a brunch mood, with a fold and no onion or garlic, making it friendly for all tastes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a shallow dish, mix together the panko breadcrumbs and a pinch of salt.
In a separate dish, whisk together the egg and a pinch of salt.
Dip each cod fillet into the egg mixture, coating completely, then roll in the breadcrumb mixture to coat.
Place the coated cod fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the fish sauce over the cod fillets and sprinkle with black pepper.
Bake the cod fillets in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until cooked through and crispy.
Warm the large tortilla pieces by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by placing a cooked cod fillet onto each tortilla, then topping with lettuce, tomato, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Fold the tortilla to enclose the filling and serve immediately.
